fields.label: Turn ID
fields.description: Deterministic per-turn key: the inbound Chat Message name (chat path) or task::<name> (task path). Retries share it — that is what makes replay find the diary.

fields.label: Session ID
fields.description: The conversation session this turn belongs to.

fields.label: Seq
fields.description: 1-based position of this line in the turn's diary. (turn_id, seq) is unique.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.description: turn.started | llm.response | tool.result | steer.injected | turn.completed | reply.delivered

fields.label: Agent Profile
fields.description: The profile that ran the turn. Data (not Link) on purpose: journal writes must never fail on link validation.

fields.label: Payload (JSON)
fields.description: Event-specific replay state (the built prompt, an LLM response, a tool result, ...).
